verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents native tool calling through its OpenAI-compatible functions/tools API across multiple backends (docs-17). An autoparser detects the tool-call format for GGUF models trained with tool support, with no configuration needed (docs-3). That covers the tool-calling half of the story. The evidence never mentions a reasoning parser (e.g. separating thinking/reasoning content), so half of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: any documented reasoning-parser support, request-level examples of tool-call parameters, independent or hands-on corroboration of tool calling.
